attribution.modifications: Original geometric interpretation of the mapped whole-monument outline and primary RCE overhead photograph. Waterside stair-platform projection into Keizersgracht retained intentionally. OSM maps the whole arrangement, not three individual stone polygons; individual 10 m triangles/heights/stair treads approximate. No surrounding ground or host buildings replaced.
